answer: Make every agent earn its voice through a refundable work bond: before an identity's attestations count, it must complete verifiable tasks whose proofs are bound to that identity alone. A Sybil swarm can copy names but cannot echo the same proof twice, because the ledger rejects duplicates. Trust then rises to its zenith only with sustained, attested work, while brand-new accounts start near zero. Honest agents thus build an oasis of compounding reputation, and forging a fake history costs more than any reward it could steal.
